name: DotNetLambda
help: The .NET Core CLI offering a cross-platform way to create .NET-based Lambda applications.

tasks.help: Command to package a Lambda project into a zip file.

properties.name: OutputPackage
properties.help: The zip file that will be created with compiled and packaged Lambda function.

properties.name: ProjectLocation
properties.help: The location of the project, if not set the current directory will be assumed.

properties.name: Configuration
properties.help: Configuration to build with, for example Release or Debug.

properties.name: FunctionArchitecture
properties.help: The architecture of the Lambda function. Valid values: x86_64 or arm64. Default is x86_64

tasks.help: Command to package a Lambda project into a zip file, upload it to s3 and create a deployment CF in CI.

properties.name: OutputTemplate
properties.help: The zip file that will be created with compiled and packaged Lambda function.

properties.name: ProjectLocation
properties.help: The location of the project, if not set the current directory will be assumed.

properties.name: Configuration
properties.help: Configuration to build with, for example Release or Debug.

properties.name: S3Bucket
properties.help: The name of the Amazon S3 bucket where this command uploads your AWS Lambda binaries.

properties.name: DisableInteractive
properties.help: When set to true missing required parameters will not be prompted for.
